edition_notes: © 2024 Wulfhorn Games; French adaptation and distribution by Gigamic; UK import by Hachette Boardgames UK; rulebook dated 02-2025. 2-5 players, ages 8+, about 20 minutes.

items.rule: Separate the cards into three decks (Store, Window, Roof), shuffle each deck, and place them face down within reach of all players.
Each player takes one card from the Store deck and places it face up in front of themselves as the start of their street.
Each player then draws 1 Store card, 1 Window card and 1 Roof card as their starting hand (3 cards).
On each turn all players act at the same time, performing three actions in order: Draw, Build, Pass your cards.
Draw: take one card of your choice from the Store, Window or Roof deck and add it to your hand, making 4 cards.
Build: choose 1 of the 4 cards in your hand and place it in your street, or discard it in your canal.
Pass your cards: pass the remaining 3 cards of your hand to the player on your left and receive a new hand of 3 cards from the player on your right.
New Stores must be built to the left or right of existing Stores in your street, never between them.
Window cards are placed above a Store or above other Windows, sliding the bottom part of the card under the previous card; Roofs go on top of the house.
A house can only be built from the ground up (Store, then Windows, then Roof); you cannot play a Roof first and add Windows and the Store later.
The canal: instead of placing a card in your street, you may place it face down horizontally under your canal; the card is discarded and can no longer be used.
There is no height limit for houses.
You may play a Roof even if it will not score points, e.g. to end the game sooner.
Windows contain Cats, Birds, Flowerpots and Flags, which let Stores and Roofs score and also give Flowerpot points.
The game ends when someone places the 4th Roof card on their street; that player announces "Heel Mooi!".
After the 4th Roof is placed, everyone completes their turn; then unused cards are set aside and final scoring begins.
If the Roof deck is exhausted, players finish the game with the Roofs left in their hands and proceed to scoring as usual.
Players score in three ways: Store and Roof objectives, Flowerpots, and the Bonus Colour for connected cards of the same color.
A Store or Roof scores its printed tulip points if its house (the set of cards above/below it) meets the card's required conditions; otherwise it scores 0.

Store and Roof conditions include having at least a number of Cats/Birds/Flags/Flowerpots, having none of a feature, a required house height (e.g. exactly 3 or 4+ cards), or being taller/shorter than neighbouring houses.
House height counts cards including at least one Store card, and size comparisons are made with the house to the left/right or both sides as shown by the icon.
Each Flowerpot on your street scores 1 point.
A house without a Roof at game end can still score its Store, and you still score all its Flowerpots.
Bonus Colour: score 4 points if your street has the largest group of orthogonally-connected cards of one color (no diagonal connections).
If there is a tie for the largest connected group of one color, all tied players receive 2 points instead of 4.
The player with the most points wins.
